title: Various energy-driven high-value-added oxidation reactions in CO2 reduction systems
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00941C, Tutorial Review
Jinyu Ding, Peijin Du, Mengqian Li, Dongpo He, Qinyuan Hu, Qingxia Chen, Xingchen Jiao, Yi Xie
We summarize a timely and in-depth survey on the development of high-value alternative oxidation reactions to the OER in CO2 reduction, including photocatalytic, electrocatalytic and multi-energy-driven catalytic CO2 reduction.
